title: Ivo and the Echo
author: C. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Edmund Blackwood, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
